assertions.name: cache_has_exactly_one_derived_rung
assertions.source: derived rungs [2], cal-anchored [3]. The dashboard stops at the first non-derived rung, so it reports k=2 -- there is no deeper DERIVED rung to report

assertions.name: producer_states_the_gate_as_anti_circularity
assertions.source: per_observable_100x_status.py: “deepest cumulative DERIVED rung only; cal-anchored rungs are cached for downstream reuse but NEVER counted toward a 100×/1× pass (that would be circular). Keying off `tier` means a future agent who proves a higher c_k Taylor-exact”

assertions.name: producer_breaks_at_first_cal_anchored_rung
assertions.source: the loop carries an explicit `break` at the first non-derived rung, so cal-anchored rungs are cached but never scored

assertions.name: err_ppb_is_stored_as_a_string_not_a_number
assertions.source: err_ppb is str '1279.'. A `isinstance(v, float)` scan over this witness returns NO value in [1000, 2000] and so reads as 'the figure is gone'. Match on the string

assertions.name: both_figures_reproduce_their_stated_miss_factors
assertions.source: derived-rung 164.0x vs full-ladder 4.836x against the 7.797 ppb L2 target. Both arithmetics are correct; only the first is parameter-free

assertions.name: correcting_agents_md_would_have_been_laundering
assertions.source: AGENTS.md's 1279 ppb / 164.0x is the DERIVED-rung figure and is correct as written. Replacing it with 37.7 ppb / 4.8x would report a ladder containing rungs extracted from CODATA Q_beta as a parameter-free accuracy result -- the move AGENTS.md forbids at CAL-1 and CAL-2, one tier down. Left unedited deliberately

description: The L2 dashboard's Q_beta figure (1279 ppb / 164x) is the deepest DERIVED c_k rung, gated deliberately against cal-anchored rungs to avoid circularity -- not a truncation artefact. Refutes the reading in bean qou-99qc that it should be 'corrected' to the full-ladder 37.7 ppb, which would count rungs extracted from the CODATA Q_beta being predicted. Scope-(a); nothing wired.
